submitted.rationale: Best of the 3 measured. Index 94 (Bi 0.09, Cu 0.52, V 0.39) gave 4.2e-7 A. That is more than twice the other two. The illumination is 2.4 eV, which sits near the BiVO4 band edge, so copper vanadates, which absorb light below 2.4 eV, should do better. The low-Bi, Cu/V-rich region performed best.

rejected.reason: BiVO4-like and V-rich: measured 1.6e-7 A, likely weak absorption at 2.4 eV
Adding Bi and removing V in the Cu-rich region lowered the photocurrent to 1.8e-7 A
